feature: owner CLI ClamAV signature recovery and selected generation cleanup

recovery: owner acknowledges provider instructions through an explicit timezone timestamp
cannot shorten the saved wait; extensions persist even before expiry
one microsecond before expiry refuses recovery; exact expiry permits it
validates current generation if present; no promotion of orphan or staging data
persists legacy freshclam.dat before clearing pending; ambiguous multiple sources are refused
updater saves provider state after success or failure and restores it before the next freshclam invocation
cleanup: single managed generation or stage ID with metadata revision
refuses current generation, in-use generation and the last previous generation
shares the cross-process updater lock; takes an exclusive generation lease before deleting
does not hold publication lock during hashing or deletion, so current generation readers can start
metadata-only bounded preflight: at most 128 entries, depth 3, 30-second preflight budget
descriptor-relative deletion without following links; refuses nonprivate ownership/mode/ACL, hardlinks, placeholders and unknown entries
never deletes attempt.json, provider.dat, current.json or lease files
I/O failure or interruption can leave partial deletion; list again and inspect remaining entries
contracts.storage: existing POSIX private-store checks; macOS allow ACLs refused; Windows management remains disabled
contracts.capacity: four generation/stage slots remain; owner-selected cleanup reclaims slots while retaining current and one previous generation
contracts.provider_wait_limit: binary freshclam state is preserved, not independently parsed; longer provider instructions must be acknowledged by the owner; native freshclam still interprets its state

cases: inventory and selected deletion preserve current reference and wait state
current/last previous generations, forged IDs and stale revisions refused
real separate-process shared lease blocks deletion until its holder exits
pending stages protected; early recovery and stale recovery revisions refused
deadline extension persists and cannot subsequently be shortened
expiry boundary preserves provider state before deleting a recovered stage
symlink/hardlink/unsafe mode and simulated dataless metadata block deletion without touching an outside file
MCP/internal unknown operation cannot dispatch maintenance
invalid timestamps and corrupt active definitions cannot clear pending
real CLI inventory prints IDs without store paths
real CLI recovery and selected stage deletion round trip
provider state survives updater failure, recovery, stage deletion and the next updater call; known partially downloaded CVD permissions normalized safely
ambiguous provider sources and changed recovery state fail closed

review_fixes.found_with: Synthetic stores and a mocked freshclam on a scratch copy of 129f038; no downloads

fixed.issue: Two failed updates left two stages with freshclam.dat; recovery refused them as ambiguous while both stages were protected as pending_recovery, so neither recovery nor deletion could proceed
fixed.reproduced: Failure, recovery, failure, then recover returned 'Ambiguous provider wait state'; both stages showed deletable=false with pending_recovery
fixed.fix: provider.dat, refreshed after every freshclam run including failures, is authoritative; stage copies are used only when it is absent (legacy stages), where ambiguity still fails closed

fixed.issue: Listing probed the current generation with an exclusive lease, so a scan or check starting at that moment failed
fixed.reproduced: check_clamav_signatures during the probe returned 'Operation could not complete'
fixed.fix: Only non-current generations are probed; scans lease only the current generation, which is protected anyway

fixed.issue: Deleting a generation left its .lease file, which counts toward the 128-entry inventory limit
fixed.reproduced: After deletion the generation folder was gone and its .lease file remained
fixed.fix: The lease file is removed while its exclusive lease is held; generation IDs are never reused

review_fixes.regressions: 2 added and 1 extended; three mutations removing the fixes were each detected
review_fixes.test_flake_fixed: An existing recovery test passed a microsecond ISO round trip of the float deadline, which lands below it in about 14% of cases and is rightly refused; recovery tests now use minimum_not_before (rounded up to whole seconds), as owners are told to
